curriculum_commitment: Every Physics content expectation from 5A through 9D is mapped to one teachable module. Scientific and engineering practices are embedded across instruction, practice, feedback, labs, and mastery checks.

units.title: Motion and Forces
units.description: Analyze motion, vectors, Newton's laws, circular motion, projectiles, and gravitation.

modules.title: Motion Graphs
modules.summary: Generate and interpret position-time, velocity-time, and acceleration-time graphs.

modules.title: Scalars and Vectors
modules.summary: Distinguish scalar and vector quantities and combine perpendicular vectors.

modules.title: One-Dimensional Motion
modules.summary: Analyze distance, displacement, speed, velocity, reference frames, and acceleration.

modules.title: Circular and Projectile Motion
modules.summary: Analyze uniform circular motion and horizontal projectile motion.

modules.title: Newton's First Law
modules.summary: Explain equilibrium and inertia using Newton's First Law.

modules.title: Forces and Newton's Second Law
modules.summary: Use free-body diagrams and F = ma to analyze common forces.

modules.title: Newton's Third Law
modules.summary: Analyze simultaneous forces between interacting objects.

modules.title: Universal Gravitation
modules.summary: Use Newton's law of universal gravitation and scientific notation.

units.title: Electricity and Magnetism
units.description: Study electric forces, charge, circuits, magnetic fields, and electromagnetic devices.

modules.title: Coulomb's Law
modules.summary: Predict electric force from charge and separation distance.

modules.title: Electric and Magnetic Fields
modules.summary: Connect electric and magnetic forces and fields to everyday devices.

modules.title: Charge Transfer
modules.summary: Investigate induction, conduction, polarization, and conservation of charge.

modules.title: Series and Parallel Circuits
modules.summary: Analyze, design, and construct series and parallel circuits.

modules.title: Ohm's Law and Electric Power
modules.summary: Calculate current, voltage, resistance, and power in circuits.

units.title: Work, Energy, and Momentum
units.description: Connect forces and motion to work, energy, impulse, momentum, and collisions.

modules.title: Work and Power
modules.summary: Calculate and explain work and power in one dimension.

modules.title: Mechanical Energy
modules.summary: Calculate kinetic and potential energy.

modules.title: Conservation of Energy
modules.summary: Apply the work-energy theorem and track energy transformations.

modules.title: Impulse and Momentum
modules.summary: Calculate and describe impulse and momentum.

modules.title: Conservation of Momentum
modules.summary: Analyze one-dimensional elastic and inelastic collisions.

units.title: Waves and Optics
units.description: Study wave motion, behavior, the electromagnetic spectrum, spectra, and image formation.

modules.title: Simple Harmonic Motion
modules.summary: Examine oscillations and wave-energy propagation.

modules.title: Transverse and Longitudinal Waves
modules.summary: Compare mechanical, electromagnetic, and sound waves.

modules.title: Wave Properties
modules.summary: Relate velocity, frequency, amplitude, and wavelength using v = fλ.

modules.title: Wave Behavior
modules.summary: Investigate reflection, refraction, diffraction, interference, standing waves, Doppler effect, polarization, and superposition.

modules.title: Electromagnetic Spectrum
modules.summary: Compare applications across the electromagnetic spectrum.

modules.title: Atomic Emission Spectra
modules.summary: Connect atomic emission spectra to the electromagnetic spectrum.

modules.title: Mirrors and Lenses
modules.summary: Describe and predict image formation using plane mirrors and thin convex lenses.

units.title: Quantum Physics
units.description: Introduce photons, polarization, superposition, wave-particle duality, uncertainty, and modern applications.

modules.title: Photons and the Photoelectric Effect
modules.summary: Describe the photoelectric effect and emission spectra using the photon model.

modules.title: Polarization and Malus's Law
modules.summary: Investigate polarization and applications using Malus's Law.

modules.title: Superposition and Wave-Particle Duality
modules.summary: Compare quantum superposition with wave-particle duality.

modules.title: Quantum Applications
modules.summary: Explore uncertainty, quantum computing, and cybersecurity applications.
